# Mod manager profile (r2modman / Thunderstore Mod Manager)

How the one-click profile zip is shaped, learned from Jordan's real
`Multivoid` profile (example zip `Multivoid_0_903a.zip`, received 2026-10-13;
it carries an older build, but the structure is what matters here).

## What the profile actually is

The profile is NOT BepInEx based. The loader is UE4SS via the Thunderstore
`unreal_shimloader` package (1.1.7). The profile is self-contained: it holds
the loader, its Lua mods, and our mod. Both managers point at the same
VotV install in Documents; the profile lives under the manager's
`<Game>/profiles/` directory.

## Zip layout

The zip has exactly one top-level folder, the profile name. Extracting it
into the manager's `profiles/` dir produces a working profile:

```
Multivoid/                                  <- profile folder; goes in <manager>/VotV/profiles/
  dwmapi.dll                                <- unreal_shimloader (static)
  ue4ss.dll                                 <- unreal_shimloader (static)
  UE4SS-settings.ini                        <- UE4SS config (static; hot reload disabled, defaults)
  mods.yml                                  <- manager package registry (GENERATED per release)
  _state/installation_state.yml             <- empty: "currentState: []" (static)
  shimloader/
    cfg/                                    <- empty dir (static)
    mod/
      Chilltivoid/                          <- OUR mod package (generated per release)
        dlls/main.dll                       <- the built mod
        enabled.txt                         <- literal "true", no trailing newline
        updater.ps1                         <- dist/updater.ps1 (F1 > Mod > Update)
        manifest.json                       <- generated by package.ps1
        icon.png, README.md, CHANGELOG.md, LICENSE, THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md
      mods.json                             <- UE4SS Lua mod enable list, JSON (static)
      mods.txt                              <- UE4SS Lua mod enable list, text (static)
      BPML_GenericFunctions/Scripts/main.lua        (static)
      BPModLoaderMod/Scripts/main.lua + load_order.txt (static)
      CheatManagerEnablerMod/Scripts/main.lua       (static)
      ConsoleCommandsMod/Scripts/*.lua              (static)
      ConsoleEnablerMod/Scripts/main.lua            (static)
      Keybinds/Scripts/main.lua                     (static)
      LineTraceMod/Scripts/main.lua                 (static)
      SplitScreenMod/Scripts/main.lua                (static)
      shared/UEHelpers/UEHelpers.lua                (static)
    pak/
      Chilltivoid/
        scientists.pak                      <- from assets/paks/ (static content, tracked)
        *_v1sc.png                          <- F1 skin browser sidecars (static)
```

## What the manager knows about the profile

`mods.yml` lists the two installed packages:

- `Thunderstore-chilltivoid`, `onlineSource: false` (side-loaded, not from Thunderstore)
- `Thunderstore-unreal_shimloader` 1.1.7, `onlineSource: true` (from Thunderstore)

Note: the chilltivoid entry's `versionNumber` (1.1.7) is the Thunderstore
store-package version, which is a different scheme from the mod's generated
`version_number` (e.g. 0.9.217) inside `manifest.json`. For the CI-generated
profile the manager entry is informational only (`onlineSource: false`), so
CI stamps it from a template with the generated version.

## Assembly mapping (per release)

Only `shimloader/mod/Chilltivoid/` changes per release. It is exactly the
`package.ps1` stage tree, relocated. `.github/ci/package-profile.ps1` does
the relocation; `build-core.yml` runs it after the package step (with
`-KeepStage`), and the profile zip rides the same artifact to `dev-latest`
next to the mod zip.

| package.ps1 stage            | profile destination                        |
|------------------------------|--------------------------------------------|
| manifest.json                | shimloader/mod/Chilltivoid/manifest.json   |
| icon.png                     | shimloader/mod/Chilltivoid/icon.png        |
| README.md                    | shimloader/mod/Chilltivoid/README.md       |
| CHANGELOG.md                 | shimloader/mod/Chilltivoid/CHANGELOG.md    |
| LICENSE                     | shimloader/mod/Chilltivoid/LICENSE         |
| THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md       | shimloader/mod/Chilltivoid/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md |
| mod/dlls/main.dll            | shimloader/mod/Chilltivoid/dlls/main.dll   |
| mod/enabled.txt              | shimloader/mod/Chilltivoid/enabled.txt     |
| mod/updater.ps1              | shimloader/mod/Chilltivoid/updater.ps1     |
| pak/*.pak + *.png            | shimloader/pak/Chilltivoid/                |

Everything else is a static skeleton checked in once. The profile zip is
named `Multivoid-r2modman-profile.zip` and attached to the rolling
`dev-latest` release, which `dist/install-profile.ps1` already downloads.

## The static skeleton

`dist/profile-skeleton/` holds the official `unreal_shimloader` package
contents (the version in `shimloader-version.txt`), checked in once: the
UE4SS DLLs, UE4SS-settings.ini, the Lua helper mods, mods.json/mods.txt,
and the empty `_state/installation_state.yml`. It is our mod's declared
dependency and the base essentially every VotV mod installs into. Refresh
it from a current official package install when the shimloader updates.

## Open decisions for the CI step

1. Whether the release signature (`mod/dlls/main.dll.sig`) rides along in
   the profile's `dlls/` dir. The dev-latest lane does not sign; the
   versioned release lane assembles its own assets in publish.ps1 and is
   untouched by this change.
2. `mods.yml` generation: template with the generated version. Done in
   package-profile.ps1; the chilltivoid entry is informational
   (`onlineSource: false`).
